svg.title: How I build: a four-step loop
svg.desc: 01 Direct: decide what to build. 02 Build with AI: pair-program with Claude and Codex. 03 Review and test: check behaviour and catch regressions. 04 Understand: study the code and architecture until I can own it. Then repeat for every feature and every fix. Level-up loop: Verified lessons become reusable skills and workflows, improving how the AI and I build together from one iteration to the next.
